0022600027.text: The 76ers (7-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a four-game winning streak) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, fifth in the East and two games back in the Central, on a one-game losing streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Philadelphia is 3-0 on the road and Cleveland is 3-1 at home, and the 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 114-106 win in Philadelphia on 2026-10-22. In the 2025-26 season series, Philadelphia lost all four meetings. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (out, hamstring soreness).
